name: es31-compute-shared-memory
title: Compute shaders: shared memory and barriers
summary: Work group cooperation through shared variables: a sum/min/max reduction of 3000 integers in two passes, Hillis-Steele and Blelloch prefix scans (the first one hierarchical over 24 work groups), memoryBarrierShared()/groupMemoryBarrier()/memoryBarrier() paired with barrier(), a shader whose shared array is exactly MAX_COMPUTE_SHARED_MEMORY_SIZE bytes, and a CPU simulation of the schedules that make an unsynchronized version wrong; every result is compared exactly and the SSBOs are drawn as bars.
spec: ES 3.2 §17 Compute Shaders, §17.1 Compute Shader Variables (MAX_COMPUTE_SHARED_MEMORY_SIZE), Table 21.49
ES 3.2 §7.11.1 Shader Memory Access Ordering, §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization (SHADER_STORAGE, BUFFER_UPDATE and VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY barrier bits)
ES 3.2 §6.3 Mapping and Unmapping Buffer Data
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.3.8 Shared Variables, §4.4.1.1 Compute Shader Inputs

GLSL ES 3.10 §8.14 Shader Invocation Control Functions (barrier), §8.15 Shader Memory Control Functions (memoryBarrierShared, groupMemoryBarrier, memoryBarrier); GLSL ES 3.20 numbers these §8.15 and §8.16

api.glCreateShader: COMPUTE_SHADER objects for the reduction (pass 1 in three fence variants, pass 2), both scans, the offset pass and the shared-memory-limit shader
api.glShaderSource: sources compiled with host-inserted '#define' lines (PASS, SHARED_FENCE, SHARED_WORDS) below #version
api.glCompileShader: a shader declaring `shared uint s[MAX_COMPUTE_SHARED_MEMORY_SIZE / 4]` compiles; all demo shaders compile
api.glLinkProgram: the program with the full-size shared array links and runs; a program one word over the limit is only reported (the specification does not require a link error)
api.glUseProgram: selects the reduction/scan/offset/limit program per dispatch; bars program for drawing
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_count and the bar uniforms are active
api.glUniform1ui: u_count (inputs of each pass, 3000 or 24), observed through exact results and the guard words
api.glUniform1i: bar x0, pitch, width and baseline in pixels, observed through the probed bar positions
api.glUniform2i: framebuffer size of the bar program, observed through the probed bar positions
api.glUniform1f: pixels per unit of the bar heights, observed through the probed tips
api.glUniform3f: bar color, compared exactly in the probes
api.glGenBuffers: SSBOs for input, partials, totals, scans, offsets and the shared-memory-limit output
api.glBindBuffer: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER and ARRAY_BUFFER targets used to create, map and use the buffers
api.glBufferData: inputs and the 0xDEADBEEF-filled result buffers; the sentinel is what unwritten words show
api.glBindBufferBase: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER binding points 0..2 select the buffers behind each shader's layout(binding) blocks; observed through exact results
api.glMapBufferRange: MAP_READ_BIT readback of every result buffer, compared exactly
api.glDispatchCompute: 24-group reductions and scans, single-group second levels, and four work groups of the shared-memory-limit shader; all results exact
api.glMemoryBarrier: SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT between dependent dispatches, BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT before every glMapBufferRange readback, VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_BARRIER_BIT before the results are drawn as vertex data; results are exact after them (necessity cannot be observed: implementations may synchronize more than required)
api.glGetIntegerv: MAX_COMPUTE_SHARED_MEMORY_SIZE >= 16384 (Table 21.49) and used to size the shared array of the limit shader
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: integer attribute 0 enabled, observed through the probed bars
api.glVertexAttribIPointer: int attribute read from the compute results with strides 4 and 16 and offsets 0, 4, 8; every bar height probed
api.glVertexAttribDivisor: divisor 1: one value per bar instance
api.glViewport: full-surface viewport maps the bar pixel coordinates
api.glClearColor: background, row and baseline colors compared
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, scissored for rows and baselines
api.glScissor: four row bands and their baselines; the rows' colors are compared beyond the bar tips
api.glDisable: SCISSOR_TEST before the bars are drawn: bars of all rows appear
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the default framebuffer, two probes per bar

visual_review.notes: Viewed the gpu (radeonsi), llvmpipe (es-min) and zink captures, 256x256, identical; the gpu one also enlarged 3x. Four horizontal bands of 64 px on a dark background, each with a thin gray baseline at mid height. Band 1 (blue): 128 two-pixel-wide bars, the input values, random spikes up and down to near the band edges. Band 2 (green): the inclusive scan of the same 128 values as a filled random-walk silhouette hanging from the baseline: a tiny positive stub at the far left, then below the baseline for the rest, deepening to its lowest point near the right end and recovering slightly at the last bars. Band 3 (orange): the exclusive scan, the same silhouette shifted by one bar (it starts at exactly zero, so no stub). Band 4: 24 clusters of three thin bars each: yellow maxima all pointing up to nearly the band height, purple minima all pointing down to nearly the band height, red sums of both signs and much smaller magnitude. No gaps, stray pixels or bars past the band edges.
